title: SourceSampleResponse
description: Response body for GET /api/data-sources/:id/sample (HEL-1628) -- the engine-loaded head (at most 1,000 rows, in engine order) of one data source, loaded exactly as a pipeline run loads it (REST/SQL flattening and row typing included), for the client draft-preview evaluator. `capturedAt` is the server time of the read. `sourceRowCount` is the total rows the source holds when known; it is always present and is null only for a truncated live read whose driver did not observe a total. `truncated` is true when the source holds more rows than were returned. `live` is true for a source that re-reads a live system (rest_api, sql, or a file kind with a source URL). Cells are value-encoded losslessly: a JVM Int is {"$int": n}, a Long is {"$long": "n"}, NaN/Infinity/-Infinity/negative zero are {"$double": "..."}, and every other JSON number is a double.
